summary: Iter13: Practice missions (reading_passage / writing_prompt) end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_practice_missions.py — 13/13 pass (happy paths for both kinds + linked passage/piece queryable + parent-only authz + student=403, anon=401, other_parent=403 + invalid kind=422 + regression: standard /missions still works, /reading/passage, /writing/prompt, /students/{id}/portfolio, /students/{id}/intake, /skills, /strategies). Frontend: verified mission-form-type selector renders all 3 chips with correct data-testids (standard/reading/writing) and default 'standard' is selected. Live POST /api/missions/practice from the parent session returned 200 with mission_type='reading_passage' (📖 Read: prefix, linked_passage_id set, steps=[]) and mission_type='writing_prompt' (✍️ Write: prefix, linked_writing_id set). Parent dashboard renders parent-mission-type-reading-{id} and parent-mission-type-writing-{id} chips on both new mission cards. Student dashboard: cards have href='/student/practice/reading/{passage_id}' and '/student/practice/writing/{piece_id}' (NOT /student/missions/{id}); step count '· N steps' is correctly suppressed on student card text (only '10 min' shows, no 'step' substring). Clicking the reading card navigated to /student/practice/reading/{passage_id} and rendered the passage title ('Emperor Penguins: Masters of Survival'), body, '5th grade' level, and the 4 questions with literal/inferential labels — the route registration miss from iter12 is now fixed. Iter12's 3 missing Route entries are confirmed registered in /app/frontend/src/App.js lines 173-196.

issues: Reading-practice and writing-practice missions still show '· 0 steps' on the parent dashboard meta line (e.g. '10 min · 0 steps'). The review request only mandated hiding step count on the STUDENT dashboard for non-standard missions (which IS correctly implemented in StudentDashboard.jsx:180). Consider applying the same conditional on ParentDashboard.jsx for visual consistency — '0 steps' is misleading because a reading mission's 'work unit' is questions, not steps.

action_items: Optional polish: in /app/frontend/src/pages/ParentDashboard.jsx, hide '· N steps' when m.mission_type !== 'standard' (mirror StudentDashboard.jsx:180). Currently parent sees '10 min · 0 steps' on every reading/writing practice card which reads as broken-data even though it's logically correct.
critical_code_review_comments: PracticeMissionRequest does NOT accept recurrence_pattern — good, matches v1 spec ('always one-off'). However the v1 contract is enforced only by omission; consider documenting in the endpoint docstring that recurrence is intentionally unsupported so future contributors don't 'helpfully' add it.

POST /missions/practice does a synchronous LLM call (generate_reading_passage / generate_writing_prompt) inside the request. On Emergent's LLM key this takes 5-15s. There is NO timeout protection on the wrapper — if the upstream LLM hangs, the FastAPI worker blocks for the full uvicorn timeout. Consider asyncio.wait_for() with a 60s budget and 504 on timeout.

If generate_reading_passage raises (e.g. validation error from LLM JSON), the mission row is NEVER inserted — good. But the partially-created ReadingPassage row IS inserted by generate_reading_passage before the mission insert. Result: orphan passage in DB on mission-creation failure. Wrap in a try/except that deletes the passage if the mission insert fails.
server.py is now ~2713 lines (was ~2630 in iter12). Strongly recommend splitting routers — missions, reading_writing, auth, students should each be a separate APIRouter mounted under /api.

MissionForm.jsx submit() still posts to /missions/practice with the full form payload (title/steps/etc) even though backend ignores them and AI generates fresh title. This is wasted bandwidth — could just send {student_id, due_date, kind, topic_hint, level_override, estimated_minutes}. Not a bug but cleaner.

Recurrence section still renders on the form when reading/writing chip is selected — the review_request explicitly says 'that's OK for v1' but it WILL confuse parents. Recommend hiding/disabling the Repeat section when missionKind !== 'standard' before public launch.
Pre-existing: 3 audio test failures in test_moments_audio.py noted from iter12 are still present and out-of-scope for this iteration.
